items.statement: The submitted investigation identifies the public molecular objects, uses the declared complex stoichiometries, and documents geometry optimization plus a stationary-point/minimum validation and conformer coverage.
items.expected: Object identity and stoichiometry are unambiguous; candidate counts, deduplication/advancement and stopping are reported; retained target structures have frequency or justified stationary-point validation.

items.statement: The binary Tb·Pa interaction energy is the paper's reported isolated-complex observable.
items.expected: A numeric binary interaction energy in kJ/mol is reported with the submitted convention and validated status.

items.statement: The C8-IL-containing Tb·Pa interaction energy is the paper's reported isolated-complex observable.
items.expected: A numeric ternary interaction energy in kJ/mol is reported with the submitted convention and validated status.
